title: 第3章 大开杀戒第4章 越阶杀敌
lines: 众人根本没有反应过来，一切都已经结束了，完全没看清发生了什么。
护卫队长李山皱起眉头，表情严肃，他乃是练气七重巅峰武者，和许辰同一境界，但此刻，他却从后者身上感受到了莫大压力。
还有就是，他感觉此时的许辰变了，变的陌生，和记忆中的少主人简直就是两个人。
许辰向前踏出一步，冰冷如刀的目光，落在秦静的身上，“秦静今天必死，谁敢阻我，杀无赦！”
护卫队长李山抽出长刀，向前一指。
一名离许辰最近的护卫，一个健步冲上去，狞笑道：“许辰，你还认不清现实吗，现在的你是阶下之囚。”
他抡起拳头朝许辰砸去。
这一拳，裹挟着刚猛的劲风，砸向许辰的面门，欲把许辰整张脸砸烂。
拳风吹起了许辰额前一缕黑发，露出了冰冷的眼眸。
许辰抬起了手，掌心向前，迎上了呼啸而来的拳头。
那名护卫准备收拳再攻之时，面色却是陡然一变，他的右拳竟然被许辰的掌心死死吸附住了，任他如何用力，都收不回来。
令他面色巨变的是，许辰掌心之中竟然传出一股惊人的吞噬之力，他体内的灵力、血气，如同泄了闸的洪水，疯狂流失。
但转瞬之间，叫声便变的虚弱不堪。
只因那名护卫，此刻已然化作一具枯萎干瘪的尸体。
护卫队长李山面色也是一变再变，最后一咬牙，厉色道：“许辰堕入魔道，大家一起出手，杀了他为民除害。”
说完，他一马当先，一跃而起，一刀劈向许辰。
content_en:
"Why did Guard Yang fly out?"
"What did Xu Chen just do?"
"I don't know, I didn't see clearly."
"Guard Yang stopped moving. Is he okay?"
It all happened so fast.
No one reacted at all, everything was over, and they didn't see what happened at all.
Qin Jing retreated calmly.
The guard captain Li Shan frowned with a serious expression. He was a seventh-level peak Qi practitioner, at the same level as Xu Chen, but at this moment, he felt great pressure from the latter.
What's more, he felt that Xu Chen had changed at this time and became a stranger. He was almost the same person as the young master in his memory.
Xu Chen took a step forward, his eyes as cold as a knife fell on Qin Jing, "Qin Jing will die today. Anyone who dares to stop me will be killed without mercy!"
"Arrogant!
Get him for me! "
The guard captain Li Shan drew out his long knife and pointed forward.
A guard who was closest to Xu Chen rushed forward with a strong stride and said with a ferocious smile: "Xu Chen, can't you understand the reality? You are a prisoner now."
Say it.
He raised his fist and punched Xu Chen.
This punch, carried by the strong wind, hit Xu Chen's face, trying to smash Xu Chen's entire face.
Before the punch arrives, the wind has arrived.
The wind from the fist blew a strand of black hair in front of Xu Chen's forehead, revealing his cold eyes.
"If you commit the following crimes, you will be punished by death!"
Xu Chen raised his hand, palm forward, to meet the roaring fist.
"Crack!"
The fists and palms met, and the strong wind raged.
When the guard was about to retract his fist and attack again, his expression suddenly changed. His right fist was actually stuck in Xu Chen's palm, and no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't take it back.
And...
What made his expression change drastically was that an astonishing devouring power came out of Xu Chen's palm. The spiritual power and blood in his body were like a flood that had been released, flowing away crazily.
"No, don't..."
he screamed in horror.
But in an instant, the cry became weak.
The expressions of other people also changed drastically.
They looked horrified.
Just because the guard had turned into a withered and shriveled corpse at this moment.
No life left at all.
"Demon, sorcery..."
A guard said tremblingly.
The expression of the guard captain Li Shan also changed again and again. Finally, he gritted his teeth and said sternly: "Xu Chen fell into the devil's path. Let's all take action together to kill him and eliminate harm for the people."
After saying that, he took the lead, jumped up, and struck Xu Chen with a knife.
title_en: Chapter 3 A killing spree Chapter 4 Killing enemies across levels
